info.name: Point Flow Backend API
info.description: Postman collection for the Point Flow backend REST API. Import this file, set `base_url`, run Bootstrap Admin or Login, then reuse `access_token` for protected endpoints. API responses use a standard envelope: `data`, `meta`, `error`, and `request_id`. Refresh tokens are stored as backend-generated HttpOnly cookies. Includes current auth, RBAC, cash register sessions, cash drawer movements, sales, sale returns, audit logs, inventory, procurement, payroll, reports, and dashboard analytics endpoints (sales trend, top products, hourly sales, low stock, sales by category, product scatter, cashier performance, procurement funnel).
